column4: AS-IS has no namespace and uses `using System; System.Collections; System.Collections.Generic; System.Linq; UnityEngine;`; TO-BE wraps the file in `namespace HeadlessDCGO.Engine.Assets.Scripts.Script.CardEffectCommons;` and replaces the UnityEngine using with headless-only usings (HeadlessDCGO.Engine.Headless.Bridge/Choices/Runtime/Services/State) plus two using-aliases (SelectPermanentEffect, PartitionCondition)
`public partial class CardEffectFactory` becomes `public static partial class CardEffectFactory` (static added)
new `internal static Func<bool>? LinkedGate(CardSource card, bool isLinkedEffect, Func<bool>? condition)` helper; grep -a for LinkedGate across DCGO/Assets/Scripts returns zero hits
new `internal static Func<CardSource, bool>? ScopePred(Func<Permanent, bool>? permanentCondition)` helper; grep -a for ScopePred across DCGO/Assets/Scripts returns zero hits

`card.Owner.MemoryForPlayer <= 2` becomes `new Player(card.Context, card.Owner).MemoryForPlayer <= 2`; AS-IS CardSource.Owner is type Player (CardSource.cs:25), TO-BE CardSource.Owner is HeadlessPlayerId (CardSource.cs:41) which has no MemoryForPlayer member (only on Player, Player.cs:648)

`IEnumerator ActivateCoroutine(Hashtable _hashtable){ yield return ContinuousController.instance.StartCoroutine(card.Owner.SetFixedMemory(3, activateClass)); }` becomes `async Task ActivateCoroutine(Hashtable _hashtable){ await card.Owner.SetFixedMemory(3, activateClass); }`

`card.Owner.Enemy.GetBattleAreaDigimons().Count >= 1` becomes `(new Player(card.Context, card.Owner).Enemy?.GetBattleAreaDigimons().Count ?? 0) >= 1`; Enemy only exists on Player (Player.cs:72), not on HeadlessPlayerId, forcing the Player wrap
same line additionally adds a null-conditional `Enemy?` and `?? 0` fallback not present in AS-IS, which unconditionally dereferences card.Owner.Enemy
IEnumerator/yield return becomes async Task/await

`Func<Permanent, bool> permamentCondition, Func<bool> condition` (non-nullable, field-name typo permamentCondition) becomes `Func<Permanent, bool>? permanentCondition, Func<bool>? condition` (nullable, typo corrected)

`string EffectDiscription() => effectDescription;` becomes `string EffectDiscription() => string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(effectDescription) ? "[Start of Your Main Phase] Gain 1 memory." : effectDescription;`, adding a default text AS-IS never had

`&& condition() && card.Owner.GetBattleAreaDigimons().Any(permamentCondition);` (unconditional calls) becomes `&& (condition is null || condition()) && (permanentCondition is null || card.Owner.GetBattleAreaDigimons().Any(permanentCondition));` (null-guarded)
IEnumerator/yield return becomes async Task/await
`if (card.Owner.ExecutingCards.Contains(card))` becomes `if (CardEffectCommons.IsExistOnExecutingArea(card))`; ExecutingCards only exists on Player (Player.cs:203), not on HeadlessPlayerId
IEnumerator/yield return StartCoroutine(...) becomes async Task/await ...

`card.PermanentOfThisCard().DigivolutionCards.Count(...)` becomes `ICardEffect.ResolvePermanentOfThisCard(card).DigivolutionCards.Count(...)`; AS-IS CardSource.PermanentOfThisCard() returns Permanent (CardSource.cs:335), TO-BE's PermanentOfThisCard() returns PermanentView (CardSource.cs:56), forcing the Permanent-typed access through ICardEffect.ResolvePermanentOfThisCard instead
IEnumerator becomes async Task

`Permanent selectedPermanent = card.PermanentOfThisCard();` becomes `= ICardEffect.ResolvePermanentOfThisCard(card);`; same PermanentOfThisCard()->PermanentView cause as CardEffectFactory.cs AS-IS:217

`customRootCardList: selectedPermanent.DigivolutionCards,` becomes `customRootCardList: selectedPermanent.DigivolutionCards.ToList(),`; AS-IS Permanent.DigivolutionCards is List<CardSource> (Permanent.cs:888), TO-BE's is IReadOnlyList<CardSource> (Permanent.cs:1766), forcing an explicit .ToList() to satisfy SelectCardEffect.SetUp's customRootCardList parameter
`yield return ContinuousController.instance.StartCoroutine(selectCardEffect.Activate());` becomes `await selectCardEffect.Activate();`

`IEnumerator SelectCardCoroutine(CardSource cardSource){ selectedCards.Add(cardSource); yield return null; }` becomes `async Task SelectCardCoroutine(CardSource cardSource){ selectedCards.Add(cardSource); await Task.CompletedTask; }`

`yield return ContinuousController.instance.StartCoroutine(CardEffectCommons.PlayPermanentCards(...));` becomes `await CardEffectCommons.PlayPermanentCards(...);` with the same named arguments and overload otherwise

AS-IS opens the coroutine with `yield return null;` then `ContinuousController.instance.PlaySE(GManager.instance.GetComponent<Effects>().BuffSE);`; TO-BE's ActivateCoroutine (starts at CardEffectFactory.cs:729) has neither line — the frame-yield and SE-play call are dropped entirely with no substitute; GManager/Effects/ContinuousController (Unity singletons) do not exist in the headless assembly

`card.Owner.UntilEndBattleEffects.Add(GetCardEffect1);` becomes `new Player(card.Context, card.Owner).UntilEndBattleEffects.Add(GetCardEffect1);`; UntilEndBattleEffects only exists on Player (Player.cs:246), not on HeadlessPlayerId

`CardEffectCommons.CanPlayAsNewPermanent(cardSource: card, payCost: false, cardEffect: activateClass1, root: SelectCardEffect.Root.Security)` becomes the same call with no root argument at all; AS-IS CanPlayAsNewPermanent accepts a root parameter (CardEffectCommons/GameContextDeterminarion.cs:303-310, default SelectCardEffect.Root.Hand), TO-BE's CanPlayAsNewPermanent (CardEffectCommons.cs:1536) dropped the root parameter from its signature entirely

`if (!card.Owner.LibraryCards.Contains(card) && !card.Owner.SecurityCards.Contains(card))` becomes `Player owner = new Player(card.Context, card.Owner); if (!owner.LibraryCards.Contains(card) && !owner.SecurityCards.Contains(card))`; LibraryCards/SecurityCards only exist on Player (Player.cs:150,135), not on HeadlessPlayerId
IEnumerator becomes async Task
second `CanPlayAsNewPermanent(..., root: SelectCardEffect.Root.Security)` call also drops the root argument; same CanPlayAsNewPermanent signature cause as CardEffectFactory.cs AS-IS:331
two nested `if (CanPlayAsNewPermanent(...)) { if (!owner.LibraryCards...) { ... } }` statements are merged into one `if (CanPlayAsNewPermanent(...) && !owner.LibraryCards...) { ... }` condition

PlayPermanentCards call switches from the activateClass:/SelectCardEffect.Root overload (cardSources:, activateClass: activateClass1, payCost:, isTapped:, root: SelectCardEffect.Root.Security, activateETB:) to the sourceCard:/ChoiceZone overload (cardSources:, sourceCard: card, payCost:, isTapped:, root: ChoiceZone.Execution, activateETB:); both overloads still coexist in TO-BE (CardEffectCommons.cs:529 and :2616, the latter still used by PlaySelfTamerSecurityEffect in this same file), and ChoiceZone defines a Security member (Headless/Choices/ChoiceZone.cs:8), so neither the overload switch nor the Security-to-Execution zone-value change is forced

`yield return new WaitForSeconds(0.2f);` (0.2s delay before deleting the played Digimon) is dropped entirely with no substitute; WaitForSeconds is a UnityEngine type unavailable in the headless assembly
`Permanent playedDigimon = card.PermanentOfThisCard();` becomes `= ICardEffect.ResolvePermanentOfThisCard(card);`; same PermanentOfThisCard()->PermanentView cause as CardEffectFactory.cs AS-IS:217

`CardEffectCommons.IsPermanentExistsOnOwnerBattleArea(playedDigimon, playedDigimon.TopCard)` becomes `CardEffectCommons.IsPermanentExistsOnOwnerBattleArea(playedDigimon, card)`; the helper's (Permanent, CardSource) signature is unchanged (CardEffectCommons.cs:1585 in TO-BE), so this is a substituted argument value, not a forced signature change
IEnumerator becomes async Task
`yield return ContinuousController.instance.StartCoroutine(new DestroyPermanentsClass(...).Destroy());` becomes `await new DestroyPermanentsClass(...).Destroy();`
AS-IS wraps the nested method bodies in #region Play Card / #region Delete Digimon Played (with matching #endregion); TO-BE has no region markers anywhere inside this method
TO-BE adds `ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(card);` as the first statement; AS-IS has no such null guard anywhere in this method

`targetPermanents: new List<Permanent>() { card.PermanentOfThisCard() }` becomes `targetPermanents: new List<Permanent>() { new Permanent(card.Context, card.InstanceId, card.Owner) }`; same PermanentOfThisCard()->PermanentView cause as CardEffectFactory.cs AS-IS:217, but here TO-BE constructs a Permanent directly instead of using ICardEffect.ResolvePermanentOfThisCard

`activateClass: activateClass` becomes `sourceCard: card`; TO-BE calls the new sourceCard:CardSource overload of DeletePeremanentAndProcessAccordingToResult (CardEffectCommons.cs:26) rather than the old activateClass:ICardEffect compatibility overload (CardEffectCommons.cs:2522) which still exists

`successProcess: permanents => SuccessProcess()` (SuccessProcess takes no params) becomes `successProcess: SuccessProcess` where local SuccessProcess now declares an unread `IReadOnlyList<Permanent> _permanents` parameter, matching the new delegate shape Func<IReadOnlyList<Permanent>, Task>
`IEnumerator SuccessProcess(){ deleted = true; yield return null; }` becomes `Task SuccessProcess(...){ deleted = true; return Task.CompletedTask; }`
outer IEnumerator/yield return becomes async Task/await

`CardSource bottomCard = card.Owner.SecurityCards.Last();` becomes `= new Player(card.Context, card.Owner).SecurityCards.Last();`; same SecurityCards Player-only cause

`if (card.Owner.CanAddSecurity(activateClass))` becomes `if (new Player(card.Context, card.Owner).CanAddSecurity(activateClass.EffectSourceCard?.InstanceId))`; AS-IS Player.CanAddSecurity(ICardEffect) (Player.cs:1469) takes an ICardEffect, TO-BE Player.CanAddSecurity(HeadlessEntityId?) (Player.cs:416) takes a nullable entity id instead
